title: Oracle Health Expands Clinical AI Agent with Coding, Dictation, and Chart Review
summary: Oracle Health Expands Clinical AI Agent with Coding, Dictation, and Chart Review Oracle
body: Oracle Health Expands Clinical AI Agent with Coding, Dictation, and Chart Review Oracle
summaryZh: Oracle Health宣布扩展其临床AI智能体功能，新增医疗编码、语音听写及病历审查能力。该更新旨在通过自动化处理繁琐的临床文档工作，提升医疗机构的运营效率与临床决策支持能力。原始信息显示：Oracle Health Expands Clinical AI Agent with Coding, Dictation, and Chart Review Oracle。该消息由Oracle发布，主题为“Oracle Health Expands Clinical AI Agent with Coding, Dictation, and Chart Review”。其重要性主要体现在：医疗领域AI智能体在临床工作流中的实际落地应用具有较高的行业参考意义。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
